scenario: Dense competing remediation candidates across eight application assets
expected_notes: The estimate profile deliberately creates competing benefit/duration trade-offs.
The input files do not encode package dependency edges; add dependency edges only through the application's actual dependency workflow.
Do not expect greedy to equal CP-SAT; independently validate feasibility and objective values.
important_contract_notes: Inventory asset_id must equal the asset external_identifier used when registering assets.
Estimate keys must be <asset external_identifier>:<OSV vulnerability id>.
Only affected installations with a fixed version and matching estimate should become approved patch actions.
Package dependency edges are not represented in inventory_offline.json; do not invent a field for them.
